_comment: Copy to <ODYSSEUS_DATA_DIR>/mlx_autoserve.json. Maps a gateway model name to an MLX model the gateway auto-serves (via Rapid-MLX) on first request. Optional per-entry fields: tool_call_parser (Rapid-MLX tool parser; e.g. 'qwen3' for Qwen, 'hermes' for Llama, 'auto' to auto-detect — needed because the gateway passes a raw repo_id Rapid-MLX can't profile), thinking (bool, default false = pass --no-thinking so message.content is populated), ctx, priority (higher survives eviction), pin (bool, never evicted), footprint_mb (override the memory estimate), rapid_extra (raw extra flags). Cloud escalation (see docs/cloud-escalation.md): cloud_model (litellm string), cloud_api_base, cloud_threshold, cloud_api_key_env (env var holding the key). Rollback: set ODYSSEUS_MLX_ENGINE=mlxlm to use the legacy mlx_lm.server (then 'venv_bin'/'trust_remote' apply). A bare string value is treated as the repo_id. Whisper STT + embeddings are NOT autoserve entries anymore — they run on the standing utility server (see io.odysseus.rapid-util.plist.example).

_escalate_example._note: Local-first with cloud fallback for hard/long tasks. Put cloud_* ONLY on a non-sensitive serve (research/escalate) — never on email/utility models — so personal data stays local. Set the key in .env under the name below, then restart.
